caption:
Delhi's airport just had its busiest first half of a fiscal year ever. 38.5 million passengers in six months.

Indira Gandhi International Airport handled 38.5 million passengers between April and September 2026 - its highest-ever first-half total, up 5% year-on-year. That's 28.1 million domestic and 10.4 million international travellers, with air traffic movements up nearly 7% and cargo up over 12%.

This record came despite known headwinds across Indian aviation this year. One hub still posted its best half-year ever.

Sources: Swarajya Mag, The Pioneer (2026)
